# Enrichment stages

From `legacy_audit/enrich/stages.py` (`STAGES`). Each stage is one JSON file in `<run>/enrichment/`, shaped by a pydantic model in `legacy_audit/enrich/models.py` (schema in `schemas/enrichment/`), written by Copilot (`/audit-enrich`) or by `legacy-audit enrich` (`legacy_audit/ai/`) and checked by `legacy_audit/enrich/validate.py`. A stage is stale when one of its inputs (fact files) or upstream stages changed since it was stamped (`enrich/status.py`). With `target.profile: none`, the stages that suggest a target are not run (`enrich.status.active_stages`).

| 1 | `overview.json` | Orient | `Overview` | components, services, screens, sql_statements, integrations, batch_jobs, libraries, tech_stack |  |
